steps.content: Norma is no fighter but an analyst. Going head-to-head with a Mania entity pushes her far past her limits. The creature's strength is crushing; she can barely hold her ground.
Mania grazes her shoulder. Pain lances through her, and she stumbles back several steps before catching herself against the wall.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: See? Rules crumble before true power. Especially rules I've already rewritten.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: Once I devour you, I'll grow even stronger... and that pathetic, cowardly half of "me"...

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: ...will be no more!
Misfortune Incarnate looms over her. Norma's glasses sit crooked on her face, her clothes disheveled, yet her voice remains calm and rational.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: But this time... you won't have it your way.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Rules can be broken. People can change.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: Oh?
Norma's sudden display of confidence gives Misfortune Incarnate pause. It stops a meter away, no longer closing in.

She removes her crooked glasses and slowly wipes them clean with the hem of her clothes. She holds the lenses up to the light to inspect them, then puts them back on. She even has the composure to check her handbag for damage.
She takes two steps forward. Though facing a Sinner far weaker than itself, Misfortune Incarnate retreats a cautious step.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: My past self would have clung to those stable, reassuring numbers and followed the analysis step by step.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: But none of that worked here. I tested, analyzed, and avoided danger. Over and over. And what did it change?

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: You're still here. The Mania is still here. The chaotic space is still here.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: And yet you still run your mouth? Look around you... That insatiable curiosity of yours will bury you in this false space forever.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Heh. On that note... perhaps I should thank you.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Even the most distorted Mania field operates on rules. Disorder and chaos, those are the rules here.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: I didn't see it at first. I kept clinging to order, and the space kept rejecting me for it.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: But now, things are different.
Norma tightens her hold on the handbag, then hurls it to the floor with every ounce of strength she has.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: <size=44><color=#fb9259>Watch this!</color></size>

Every beacon she planted, every data point she calibrated, and every broken rule she hammered back into shape all gather into this one swing. The strike cleaves through the entity's body. Spatial rifts tear across its form, locking it where it stands.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: ...!!!

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Surprised? While we were fighting, I scrambled every Mania configuration in this space.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: Impossible...! You couldn't have done that, not in that little time!

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Untangling a knot takes patience, but cutting the thread takes only a second.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: The rules here are inherently chaotic. The moment you tried to rewrite them to suppress me, to box me in, I knew... that was my opening.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: One more thing. If taking Murphy's form wasn't a coincidence, then I'm not the one you should be facing.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: ...!!!
Though the strike only slows the shadow for a moment, it is enough for Norma to leap into the spatial rift.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: I'll leave the rest of this mess to them. I've done my part as an analyst.
